steps.name: FRESH_EVALUATOR_VALIDATION

steps.name: RESUME_FORMAL_CASE_AND_PREPARE_HUMAN_VALIDATION
steps.finding: The formal continuation was not started because preceding engineering gates failed. Original C94 remains frozen. Existing launch and campaign contracts were checked without accessing the application database; real human validation and the two-iteration User Twin demonstration remain outstanding.

Expose a validated 30..540 second generation limit, record it in runtime identity and health, and set HTTP timeout above it. The model generation deadline is cooperative, not a process-kill guarantee.

source_qualification.upstream_provenance: Approved deterministic synthetic fixture artifacts; only source/repair generation used the live proposal provider. This does not establish a complete real-provider requirements/design/architecture workflow.
source_qualification.trial_unit: Five exploratory conditions on ONE synthetic reservation use case, each targeting WEB_STATIC/JVM_JAVA/JVM_KOTLIN/JVM_SCALA. These are not 20 independent real-world projects.
independent_requirements: Two valid guests yield distinct nonempty reservation identifiers.
Empty and whitespace-only guest input is rejected without corrupting earlier records.
Web pointer and keyboard actions reach the same application behavior.
JVM no-argument launch is finite and demonstrates valid behavior.

positive_runner_counterexamples.finding: Arithmetic calculator APIs satisfy self-generated tests but implement the wrong approved reservation domain.
Identifier generation and blank-input rejection pass; no guest record storage or retrieval is implemented.

isolated_core_probe.finding: A separate short-prompt JavaScript core passed unchanged business assertions after correcting a valid CommonJS export binding in the oracle. This is a limited capacity probe, not full application qualification or proof that training is unnecessary.

harness_and_infrastructure_limits: The current bounded generator pins Static Web to three files and JVM to two files. Larger application layouts require a separately validated extension of this protocol.

Earlier Web admission probes omitted a keyboard assertion or used browser_routes instead of declared_routes. Those HTTP 422 records are retained separately and excluded from real execution counts; corrected follow-ups produced actual failed attempts.
Candidate 2 Kotlin BUILD included an infrastructure permission error when hashing MainKt.class; it is not classified as a pure model compilation failure.

Independent Web oracle bindings and JVM reflection/source inspection were reviewed for alternative valid interfaces; no complete business API was found. No method-name-only failure is treated as full functional proof.
Self-generated tests were never replaced or weakened to turn a failed qualification into success.

proposals.finding: Only an opening JSON brace was produced under the bounded 4B request.
The coder returned the original source unchanged; independent binding replay rejected repair must change content.
With verified compiler logs, the coder replaced the five-test suite with two unapproved ScalaTest imports and no assertions.

repair_qualification.harness_limit: The first rejection fixture returned HTTP 503 because its JVM operation store was not configured. The corrected disposable fixture persisted the same exact rejection; both records are retained.

evaluator_comparison.candidate_origin: Prior project review decision-focused QLoRA run; this campaign only evaluates the unchanged candidate.
limitations: Primary judgement/provenance checks and domain acceptance are distinct from the separately reported exact criterion/cardinality check; a primary pass alone is not full qualification.
Secondary epistemic counters include only outputs that first pass strict JSON/schema validation; invalid or incomplete JSON is retained as a separate failure.
Six synthetic fixture families, two locales and three counterfactual states. This is not comprehensive accessibility conformance, human behavior evidence, or broad domain generalization.
Fresh case identities and DOM structures differ from prior data, while the high-level task families remain related.
Greedy decoding is used only to make the model comparison controlled; it does not replace the real proposal providers with deterministic fake adapters.
Benchmark decisions do not demonstrate multi-User-Twin orchestration or automatic weight updates through dialogue.

historical_and_formal_evidence.expert_validation_scope: The existing protocol specifies blinded descriptive expert judgments and explicitly does not establish target-user behavior. No ratings, participants or empirical results were fabricated or collected by this campaign.
historical_and_formal_evidence.scope: Historical validation remains evidence for its original scope and commit. Registration in the execution profile catalog does not confer a new Level D validation.

remaining_work_in_order: Owner reviews and subdivides the verified changes into commits, pushes, and obtains successful CI evidence for the exact resulting commit.
Diagnose and resolve bounded Kotlin dependency preparation instability without weakening pinned runner boundaries; complete and seal new Web/JVM qualification where applicable.

Build a separately reviewed source/repair curriculum and independent held-out business suite; use verified examples and never accepted-but-unqualified generated outputs as training truth. The observed failures justify focused development but do not yet identify a uniquely necessary training solution.
Require a genuinely safe real model repair, exact gate approval, unchanged independent assertions, and a successful governed rerun.
Complete broader evaluator checks and two linked independent User Twin evaluation/aggregation/design-revision cycles before formal claims.
Start a new formal continuation and collect real participant validation only after the preceding gates pass; preserve original C94.
